col.name: AGE
description: Age at which the condition or disease was first diagnosed, in years.

col.name: DFS_MONTHS
description: Disease free survival in months since initial treatment.

col.name: DFS_STATUS
description: Disease free status since initial treatment. Value must be prefixed with 0: (no event) or 1: (event occurred).

col.name: GENDER
description: Gender or sex of the patient.

col.name: OS_MONTHS
description: Overall survival in months since initial diagnosis.

col.name: OS_STATUS
description: Overall patient survival status. Value must be prefixed with 0: (no event) or 1: (event occurred).

col.name: PATIENT_DISPLAY_NAME
description: Patient display name shown in the patient view header.

col.name: PATIENT_ID
description: Unique patient identifier. Allowed characters: numbers, letters, points, underscores, and hyphens.

col.name: SEX
description: Sex of the patient.

col.name: TUMOR_SITE
description: Tumor site of the patient.

col.name: ASCN.CCF_EXPECTED_COPIES
description: Cancer-cell fraction if mutation exists on major allele. Required if ascn namespace is specified.

col.name: ASCN.CCF_EXPECTED_COPIES_UPPER
description: Upper error for CCF estimate. Required if ascn namespace is specified.

col.name: ASCN.EXPECTED_ALT_COPIES
description: Estimated number of copies harboring mutant allele. Required if ascn namespace is specified.

col.name: CANCER_TYPE
description: Cancer type. Overrides study-wide cancer type.

col.name: CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED
description: Cancer type detailed, a sub-type of the specified CANCER_TYPE.

col.name: DRIVER_MUTATIONS
description: Driver mutation annotations.

col.name: ERG_FUSION_ACGH
description: ERG fusion status determined by aCGH.

col.name: ETS_RAF_SPINK1_STATUS
description: ETS/RAF/SPINK1 molecular status.

col.name: GLEASON_SCORE
description: Radical prostatectomy Gleason score for prostate cancer.

col.name: HISTOLOGY
description: Histological classification.

col.name: KNOWN_MOLECULAR_CLASSIFIER
description: Molecular classification of the sample.

col.name: SERUM_PSA
description: Serum PSA level.

col.name: TMPRSS2_ERG_FUSION_STATUS
description: TMPRSS2-ERG fusion status.

col.name: TUMOR_GRADE
description: Tumor grade.

col.name: TUMOR_STAGE_2009
description: Tumor stage (2009 staging system).

col.name: METASTATIC_SITE
description: Overrides patient-level TUMOR_SITE for metastatic samples.

col.name: PRIMARY_SITE
description: Overrides patient-level TUMOR_SITE for primary samples.

col.name: SAMPLE_CLASS
description: Sample class label.

col.name: SAMPLE_DISPLAY_NAME
description: Sample display name shown in addition to the sample ID.

col.name: SAMPLE_ID
description: Unique sample identifier. Allowed characters: numbers, letters, points, underscores, and hyphens.

col.name: SAMPLE_TYPE
description: Sample type. Affects timeline icon color: recurrence/recurred/progression/progressed=orange; metastatic/metastasis=red; primary/other=black.

col.name: TUMOR_TISSUE_SITE
description: Tumor tissue site. Same timeline color behavior as SAMPLE_TYPE.

col.name: TUMOR_TYPE
description: Tumor type. Same timeline color behavior as SAMPLE_TYPE.

col.name: AGENT
description: Agent used in treatment with number of cycles if applicable.

col.name: AGENT_CLASS
description: Classification group for agents.

col.name: DIAGNOSTIC_TYPE
description: Diagnostic tool used (timeline IMAGING event), e.g. MRI, CT scan.

col.name: DIAGNOSTIC_TYPE_DETAILED
description: Detailed description of the diagnostic event type.

col.name: EVENT_TYPE
description: Category of the timeline event.

col.name: SPECIMEN_SITE
description: Site from where the specimen was collected (timeline SPECIMEN event).

col.name: SPECIMEN_TYPE
description: Specimen type.

col.name: START_DATE
description: Start point of event calculated in days from the date of diagnosis (day 0).

col.name: STATUS
description: Status value for timeline STATUS events (e.g. best response, stage progression).

col.name: STOP_DATE
description: End date of event in days from diagnosis. Blank for point-in-time events.

col.name: STYLE_COLOR
description: Hexadecimal color value for rendering this event (e.g. #ffffff).

col.name: STYLE_SHAPE
description: Shape for rendering this event in timeline.

col.name: SUBTYPE
description: Treatment subtype. Medical: Chemotherapy, Hormone Therapy, Targeted Therapy, etc. Radiation: WPRT, IVRT, etc.

col.name: TEST
description: Type of test performed (timeline LAB_TEST event).

col.name: TL_PATIENT_ID
description: Patient ID from the dataset (timeline context).

col.name: TL_RESULT
description: Result value for lab test or imaging.

col.name: TL_SAMPLE_ID
description: Links timeline event to a sample.

col.name: TL_SOURCE
description: Source/location where event was performed.

col.name: TREATMENT_TYPE
description: Treatment type (timeline TREATMENT event).
